# SumUp

Skills that teach agents to work with SumUp. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [sumup/sumup-skills](https://github.com/sumup/sumup-skills), at commit `6922c70`.

Skills for SumUp payment integrations across terminal and online checkout flows

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **SumUp**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **SumUp**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install sumup@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

6 skills: `sumup`, `sumup-best-practices`, `sumup-debug`, `sumup-mcp`, `sumup-testing`, `upgrade-sumup`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `SUMUP_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/sumup/sumup-skills
